SETUP_TOKEN.description: Secret you type once at /setup to create the first admin. Any long random string (for example from `openssl rand -hex 24`).

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string, for example a Cloud SQL database (postgres://user:password@host/db). Leave empty to try it out with SQLite inside the container: that data is lost whenever the container restarts.

DEMO_MODE.description: true turns on the public read-only demo account on the sign-in page. Leave false for a real workspace.
